title: date -J record
description: One time printed by `date -J` (one per line of --file). Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

time.description: The time shown: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

time_ns.description: The time shown: nanoseconds since the epoch.

utc_offset.description: The local time zone's offset from UTC at that time, in seconds east.

zone.description: The local time zone's abbreviation at that time (`%Z`).

zone_bytes.description: The bytes of `zone`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`zone` then holds the lossy form).

formatted.description: The time as date would print it (FORMAT, or the default format).

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
